technical_and_design_decisions: Each module will be migrated as a standalone Spring Cloud Stream application using the functional programming model (java.util.function.Function/Consumer/Supplier).
Use Spring Boot 3.x and Spring Cloud Stream 4.x as the base framework, which requires Java 17+.
Build configuration will use Maven (consistent with typical Spring Cloud Stream projects) with a parent POM from the s-c-s repository.
Module configurations (bindings, properties) will be externalized using application.yml or application.properties, leveraging Spring Cloud Stream's binding properties.

Existing Spring XD module logic will be adapted to fit the Spring Cloud Stream programming model, replacing XD-specific annotations with standard Spring Boot annotations and StreamListener (or functional beans).
Unit and integration tests will be written using JUnit 5 and Spring Boot test slices, with embedded broker (e.g., RabbitMQ binder test container) for integration testing.
Code review and documentation will follow the established practices of the s-c-s repository.
assumptions: The source code of the Spring XD modules is available and well-documented, with clear separation of concerns.
The s-c-s repository has a standard structure for source and sink modules, including a common parent POM and CI configuration.
Each module is self-contained with minimal external dependencies, and no major architectural changes are required beyond adapting to the new framework.
The mail module appearing in both U2 (source) and U7 (sink) refers to the same module; it will be migrated once, covering both source and sink configurations.
The team has prior experience with both Spring XD and Spring Cloud Stream, reducing learning curve.
No additional performance optimization or feature enhancements are required; the goal is functional parity with the original XD modules.
All required dependencies (e.g., for Hadoop, MongoDB, etc.) are available in the s-c-s repository's dependency management or can be easily added.
Effort estimates assume no unexpected issues from external library incompatibilities or API changes.

Port the syslog source module from Spring XD to Spring Cloud Stream, including code adaptation, configuration, unit tests, integration tests, documentation, and code review.

Port the mail module (used as both source and sink) from Spring XD to Spring Cloud Stream, including code adaptation for both modes, configuration, unit tests, integration tests, documentation, and code review.
Port the tcp source module from Spring XD to Spring Cloud Stream, including code adaptation, configuration, unit tests, integration tests, documentation, and code review.
Port the tcp-client source module from Spring XD to Spring Cloud Stream, including code adaptation, configuration, unit tests, integration tests, documentation, and code review.
Port the gpfdist sink module from Spring XD to Spring Cloud Stream, including code adaptation, configuration, unit tests, integration tests, documentation, and code review.
Port the hdfs-dataset sink module from Spring XD to Spring Cloud Stream, including code adaptation, configuration, unit tests, integration tests, documentation, and code review.
Port the mongo sink module from Spring XD to Spring Cloud Stream, including code adaptation, configuration, unit tests, integration tests, documentation, and code review.
Perform end-to-end integration testing of all migrated modules together in a sample streaming pipeline, fix any cross-module issues, and finalize documentation and build configuration.
